product_metadata.title: Geedel Rotary Cheese Grater, Kitchen Mandoline Vegetable Slicer with 3 Interchangeable Blades, Easy to Clean Rotary Grater Slicer for Fruit, Vegetables, Nuts
features: 🧀Geedel Cheese Grater Makes Everything Suuuper Easy - Like the fresh cheese? Just forget your bagged cheese! Only turn the handle for several times and you will get fresh shredded cheese, go ahead for your favourite recipes with this kitchen grater! No cutting skills required, the unique drum cutting design makes the kitchen grater cut the ingredients 12x faster than other cheese shredders. More time saved in food preparation and you will get more time to enjoy your meal with your loved ones!

🧀Premium Quality of the Cheese Grater - All parts of the rotary grater are made from food grade material and non-toxic BPA-free, which are safe to use. No electrical needed. The 3 different shaped blades are made from 430 stainless steel and will not dull or rust, ensuring you can grate ingredients faster. We also committed to let our customer enjoy healthy food with ease so we only produce safe products and hope every customer can be satisfied with our product and service.

🧀Thoughtful Design, More Than a Fast Cutting Rotary Grater - The powerful suction base keeps the cheese grater firm in place on a clean or smooth counter-tops, for better operating and enjoyment of hand grinding. Plus, the transparent barrel have an inclined curvature to allow the grated ingredients to fall smoothly and reduce jamming from the grater. We also pay high attention to our customer experience, we offer a 365-day warranty and 24 hours customers service.

🧀Mutil Purpose Rotary Cheese Grater - Still using a single function kitchen gadget? Why not choose our 3-in-1 multifunctional grater for kitchen! Finish your food preparation with 3 interchangeable blades and makes slicing, shredding and grinding easily, which is perfect for grating cheese, radish, carrot, cucumber, carrot, potato, zucchini, cookie, chocolate, broccoli, cauliflower, peanuts, almonds, ice, etc. for salad, pizza toppings, cauliflower rice, hash brown, taco, smoothie and so on.

🧀Free Your Hands with Our Vegetable Slicer - The cheese grater with handle protects your hands from all sides during use: the handle replaces your hands in rotating and the food pusher keeps your hands away from the blades. In addition, inward-facing design of the blade is available for safe cleaning. Recommended 3 blades and transparent barrel for dishwasher safe.

🎁As Seen on TV - Your Best Gift -The cheese grater will be the perfect gift choice to show your family, loved ones or friends that you care on Christmas, New Year's or other special occasions. This rotary cheese grater helps spending less time preparing food possible and allows you enjoy more moments with your family.
